1.title: Where Election Deniers Are County Election Officials
1.summary: Our politics reporter Nick Corasaniti discusses a Times analysis of a Voting Rights Lab database identifying county-level election officials overseeing key midterm elections who are also affiliated with the election-denier movement.

2.title: A Growing Number of Election Deniers Hold Key Local Roles in Midterms
2.summary: These officials oversee or help administer elections in counties across the nation where competitive House and Senate races will determine control of Congress.

3.title: Cashing in on SpaceX: 'Every chance I get, I'll sell a little more'
3.summary: Andre Lavoie joined SpaceX in 2009 as an engineer, now he's looking to cash in his shares in the company.

4.title: Afghan boxer accused of killing Scottish aid worker back in court
4.summary: Sharif Ahmadzai, who is 26 and from Afghanistan, faces charges of homicide with intent, robbery and weapons offences.

5.title: Ukraine Is Pleading for Air Defenses. Will the World Listen Anymore?
5.summary: Western allies are more hesitant to give up interceptor missiles they may need for their own defense as war rages on multiple fronts.

6.title: Indian journalist Tarun Tejpal sentenced to 10 years in jail for rape
6.summary: Tejpal, who has denied the accusations, can appeal against the verdict in India's Supreme Court.
